problem_statement: The Collin source contract lacks an implementation-ready, adapter-local foundation for exact decoding of the measured 17-byte NUMERIC wrapper, validation of the privacy-minimized AD_Public projection, and deterministic separation of current and certified observations. The work must not approve account identity, acquire county data, introduce an Access runtime, or create production ingestion or publication behavior.
desired_outcome: Define a synthetic-only Collin adapter contract that decodes supported NUMERIC values without floating-point conversion, fails closed on malformed values and incompatible schemas, creates typed adapter-local records with separate current and certified observations, preserves physical rows and source identifiers without account-key claims, and keeps provenance and diagnostics within the approved privacy boundary.

planning_decisions.decision_text: Treat the physical numeric representation as the reader-specific 17-byte wrapper: byte 0 is the canonical sign, followed by four most-significant-word-first 32-bit magnitude words whose bytes are little-endian. Require external precision from 1 through 28 and scale from 0 through precision; decode with exact Decimal arithmetic and reject negative zero, unsupported signs, invalid metadata, wrong widths, non-bytes values, and precision overflow. This is not a universal Access, Jet, Automation DECIMAL, or OLE DB DB_NUMERIC layout.

Support exactly the AD_Public table and the privacy-minimized projection comprising prop_id, geo_id, property_status, curr_val_yr, cert_val_yr, the eleven curr_* value fields, and the eleven cert_* value fields. Bind exact case-sensitive names, validate physical type, width, precision, scale, and nullability, fail closed on missing, duplicate, colliding, aliased, positional, or incompatible required structure, and calculate a canonical SHA-256 fingerprint over every observed descriptor. Additional columns remain metadata-only and produce a bounded warning.

Emit current fields and consistently populated certified fields as separate immutable adapter-local observations. Each observation retains its source family, source year, status, exact source-column lineage, caller-supplied release identifier and source member, table, one-based physical row number, parser contract version, and schema fingerprint. Matching years or values do not permit merging, overwriting, suppression, relabeling, or family-to-family filling.

Accept prop_id only as a non-bool integer from 1 through 2147483647 without approving it as an account key. Trim geo_id using the approved ASCII-whitespace rules, preserve its remaining case, punctuation, and leading zeroes, and reject empty, overlong, NUL, or C0-control values. Enforce approved status, year, monetary, null-family, exact Decimal, diagnostic, privacy, implementation-scope, and Issue 43 boundaries. Keep all implementation adapter-local, synthetic, and non-production.

task_slices.title: Add independent Collin NUMERIC and row fixtures
task_slices.description: Apply D1 through D4 by adding independently authored literal byte vectors and synthetic schema and row fixtures for zero, signed, scaled, multiword, precision-boundary, year, monetary, dual-family, malformed, repeated-row, and privacy cases. Expected values must be reviewed independently of the decoder, and fixtures must contain no county, owner, mailing, address, or production data.

task_slices.title: Implement Collin numeric and structural contracts
task_slices.description: After task 1.1, implement the adapter-local exact NUMERIC decoder, descriptor types, canonical schema fingerprint, required AD_Public projection, stable structural diagnostics, and fail-closed compatibility validation. Do not add a runtime reader, network access, county artifact, or dependency.

task_slices.title: Implement typed Collin records and dual observations
task_slices.description: After task 2.1, add adapter-local typed source records, exact source-native values, identifier and status validation, current and certified observation conversion, mandatory provenance, and physical-row preservation. Do not introduce the shared abstractions or production release-processing boundary owned by Issue 43.

task_slices.title: Complete Collin failure, privacy, and boundary tests
task_slices.description: After tasks 1.1, 2.1, and 3.1, extend the adapter tests and synthetic fixtures to cover malformed numeric representations, incompatible schemas, invalid identifiers and years, monetary limits, certified-family consistency, repeated-row preservation, bounded diagnostics, excluded owner and address fields, architecture boundaries, and the non-production runtime posture.

task_slices.title: Document the Collin decoder foundation
task_slices.description: After task 4.1, add bounded source documentation describing the reader-specific 17-byte wrapper, independent fixtures, schema and dual-roll semantics, unresolved account identity, physical-row preservation, provenance and diagnostics, privacy restrictions, source-license boundary, Issue 43 dependency, resource limitations, and non-production status. Link to the OpenSpec change rather than duplicating its normative requirements.

requirements.title: Decode the bounded NUMERIC wrapper exactly
requirements.normative_rule: The Collin adapter SHALL decode only the approved 17-byte NUMERIC wrapper by interpreting its canonical sign byte and four most-significant-word-first little-endian magnitude words, applying external precision and scale metadata with Decimal arithmetic, and SHALL NOT convert through binary floating point, silently round, or coerce the exponent.

scenarios.name: Decode independent signed and multiword vectors
given: independently authored 17-byte positive, negative, scaled, multiword, boundary, 2025, 2026, and monetary byte literals
reviewed expected Decimal values and approved precision and scale metadata
then: the exact reviewed Decimal value is returned
the declared precision and scale remain available to the adapter record
no float conversion, rounding, or exponent coercion occurs

requirements.title: Reject malformed or unsupported NUMERIC representations
requirements.normative_rule: The Collin adapter MUST reject non-bytes inputs, buffers not exactly 17 bytes, unsupported sign bytes, absent or invalid precision and scale metadata, precision overflow, negative zero, and malformed non-null numeric values with stable diagnostic codes, and MUST NOT convert those values to null or floats.

scenarios.name: Reject a negative-zero buffer
given: a 17-byte buffer with sign byte 0x01 and sixteen zero magnitude bytes
then: decoding fails with the negative_zero diagnostic code
no Decimal value or partial row is accepted
the malformed value is not treated as null

requirements.title: Validate the bounded AD_Public structural contract
requirements.normative_rule: The Collin adapter SHALL bind the approved AD_Public fields by exact case-sensitive name, validate required physical type, width, precision, scale, and nullability, reject missing or unexpected tables, missing columns, duplicate names, ASCII case-fold collisions, aliases, positional bindings, and incompatible descriptors, and SHALL compute the canonical SHA-256 schema fingerprint from every observed descriptor.

scenarios.name: Reject a case-colliding required column
given: schema metadata for AD_Public containing both curr_market and CURR_MARKET
scenarios.when: the adapter validates the observed schema
then: validation fails before row conversion with column_name_collision
the observed schema fingerprint is available to the bounded diagnostic
neither column is selected through positional or case-insensitive binding

requirements.title: Validate identifiers, years, status, null relationships, and money
requirements.normative_rule: The Collin adapter MUST validate prop_id, geo_id, property_status, value years, certified-family null consistency, and appraisal monetary ranges according to the approved lexical and numeric rules, preserving exact Decimals and rejecting invalid, negative, silently rounded, or family-filled values.

scenarios.name: Reject certified values without a certified year
given: a structurally compatible synthetic AD_Public row
then: conversion fails with inconsistent_certified_family
no certified observation is emitted
the current family is not used to supply a certified year or replacement value

requirements.title: Emit separate current and certified observations
requirements.normative_rule: The Collin adapter SHALL emit one current observation from curr_val_yr and the current value family and, when the certified family is populated consistently, a separate certified observation from cert_val_yr and the certified value family; one family MUST NOT overwrite, merge with, suppress, relabel, or fill missing values in the other.

scenarios.name: Preserve two observations from one physical row
given: a synthetic row with current year 2026 and property status Preliminary
the same row with certified year 2025 and populated certified values
scenarios.when: the adapter converts the physical row
then: one current observation classified as preliminary is emitted for 2026
one separate certified observation is emitted for 2025
each value identifies its exact current or certified source column
both observations retain the same physical-row provenance without becoming one record

requirements.title: Preserve source identifiers and repeated rows
requirements.normative_rule: The Collin adapter SHALL preserve prop_id, geo_id, and every accepted physical row with its one-based row number, SHALL keep prop_id and geo_id distinct, and MUST NOT declare either field or their combination to be an approved unique account key, deduplicate repeated rows, or infer an account roll-up.

scenarios.name: Retain repeated source rows
given: two valid synthetic rows sharing the same prop_id and geo_id
then: two source records are retained
each record retains its own physical-row provenance
no account-key approval, deduplication, owner association, or aggregate roll-up is produced

requirements.title: Retain bounded provenance and privacy-safe diagnostics
requirements.normative_rule: Every accepted observation SHALL retain the caller-supplied release identifier and source member, table name, one-based physical row number, parser contract version, schema fingerprint, source family, source year, property status, and exact source columns, while diagnostics MUST contain only approved stable codes and bounded metadata and MUST NOT contain complete rows, arbitrary values, owner or DBA names, mailing or situs addresses, protected identities, credentials, or host-local paths.

scenarios.name: Report an invalid identifier without echoing source data
given: a synthetic row whose geo_id contains a prohibited C0 control character
other fields containing sentinel text that must not appear in diagnostics
then: validation fails with invalid_geo_id
the diagnostic may identify geo_id, the row number, and schema fingerprint
the diagnostic does not contain the complete row or any sentinel field value

requirements.title: Keep the foundation synthetic, local, and non-production
requirements.normative_rule: The change SHALL use only independently authored synthetic or independently redistribution-safe fixtures within property_tax_adapters and bounded source documentation, SHALL NOT contact a county source, commit a county artifact or production record, add an Access runtime or network dependency, modify domain or application contracts, add service or DAG integration, publish owner data, or claim production readiness.

scenarios.name: Run the contract suite without external artifacts
given: a clean repository checkout containing only the committed synthetic Collin fixtures
no Access database, county archive, network access, owner data, or production credential
scenarios.when: the Collin adapter contract tests run
then: decoder, schema, row, observation, provenance, and diagnostic tests execute from synthetic inputs
no Access container or external source is required
no domain, application, service, DAG, persistence, or publication output is created

risks: The measured 17-byte reader output could be misrepresented as a universal Access or Jet wire format; documentation and tests must name it as a reader-specific, versioned physical contract. Source: 3321aaed641cd22210fac979.

Synthetic fixtures prove deterministic arithmetic and mappings but do not prove compatibility with a live Collin release or production Access reader; production-ready status must remain false. Sources: 3321aaed641cd22210fac979, 05e1317dff1c2a0b0cdc4827.

A future implementation could incorrectly infer unique account identity from prop_id or collapse repeated rows; types and tests must preserve source-native identifiers and one-based row provenance. Sources: c3dd5eb82533bab379d6af62, 8230e8434d4ed3576ea75416, a8d0164e015d086c00140812.

Fixtures or diagnostics could leak owner-bearing or arbitrary source values; a closed diagnostic vocabulary, synthetic identity-free fixtures, and sentinel-redaction tests are required. Sources: 8230e8434d4ed3576ea75416, 7676ed46a8bb877ba7fdaac0.
security_privacy_considerations: No network access, source contact, production credential, county archive, Access database, host-local path, or runtime secret is required or authorized. Sources: 515a41057d446a949cae5adc, 8230e8434d4ed3576ea75416, c83b55e968e3981f0030935d.

Owner and mailing-address publication remains default-deny; owner, DBA, mailing, situs, and protected-identity fields are excluded from the projection, records, fixtures, extras, and diagnostics. Sources: be2861af666dfc3b02456915, 8230e8434d4ed3576ea75416, a8d0164e015d086c00140812.

Diagnostics are limited to stable codes, field or table name, one-based row number, and schema fingerprint; complete rows, arbitrary values, credentials, and host paths are prohibited. Source: 8230e8434d4ed3576ea75416.
migration_compatibility_concerns: Data migration: no database, persisted schema, Bronze, Silver, or Gold migration is authorized or required because this is additive pre-production adapter work. Sources: 515a41057d446a949cae5adc, 8230e8434d4ed3576ea75416.
Backfill: no backfill is required or permitted because the change does not acquire, persist, normalize, or publish a Collin release. Source: 515a41057d446a949cae5adc.

Rollback: revert or delete the adapter-local decoder, records, tests, synthetic fixtures, and bounded documentation; no stored release or published product requires repair. Sources: 515a41057d446a949cae5adc, 05e1317dff1c2a0b0cdc4827.

Source licensing: commit only independently authored synthetic or independently redistribution-safe fixtures; no redistribution conclusion is made for a live Collin artifact. Sources: 7676ed46a8bb877ba7fdaac0, 05e1317dff1c2a0b0cdc4827.

Compatibility: the work is additive and adapter-local and does not alter domain, application, service, DAG, persistence, publication, API, workflow, infrastructure, or deployment behavior. Sources: 8230e8434d4ed3576ea75416, 76e21fb4c68b6f87724edaac, c83b55e968e3981f0030935d.

Schema compatibility is gated by required descriptors rather than the fingerprint; column order is irrelevant, while additional columns alter the fingerprint and produce a warning without being read into records. Source: be2861af666dfc3b02456915.

A future production Access runtime must prove that its output matches this wrapper or introduce a separately reviewed physical contract; this change selects or installs no runtime. Source: 3321aaed641cd22210fac979.
non_goals: Live Collin discovery, HTTP probing, download, source contact, ZIP extraction, or Access-container extraction.
Selecting, installing, or approving a production Access runtime or a new dependency.
Treating Texas Open Data as a transparent replacement for the measured Access source.
Approving prop_id, geo_id, or any combination as unique account identity.
Deduplicating repeated physical rows, reconstructing owner associations, or defining an account roll-up.
Defining shared vendor-neutral record, provenance, native-value, streaming, or production release-processing abstractions owned by Issue 43.
Changing property_tax_domain, property_tax_application, services, DAGs, workflows, policies, infrastructure, provider configuration, authentication, deployment, or production configuration.
Adding Bronze persistence, database migrations, Silver normalization, Gold publication, API behavior, backfills, or Airflow integration.
Publishing owner, mailing-address, DBA, situs, protected-identity, tax-bill, payment, delinquency, penalty, or interest data.
Claiming that the Collin adapter or any county adapter is production-ready.
blocked_reasons: The generated OpenSpec change remains a draft until an authorized maintainer merges it; decisions D1 through D4 are resolved only for drafting and each requires human merge acceptance.
Non-bootstrap implementation must not begin before the issue-linked OpenSpec change is accepted.
Implementation must remain outside the production and shared abstraction boundaries owned by Issue 43.

evidence_citations.excerpt: Implement the first production-grade Collin CAD Access source-contract decoding foundation using independently derived synthetic fixtures only.
Required table: exactly AD_Public. Additional tables are unsupported.
Current and certified observations SHALL be separate immutable records even when their years or values match.
The decoder remains a synthetic, adapter-local contract foundation.
The artifact contains current and certified field families in the same row.
collin-cad-source-contract: Evidence-backed Collin PACS Access export discovery, remote-probe, dual-roll, numeric-decoding, identity, and privacy behavior.
Adapters translate external formats and implement ports; source-specific fields stop at this boundary.
Commit only small synthetic or redistribution-safe fixtures.
Requirements use SHALL/MUST and four-hash Scenario headings with WHEN/THEN steps.
Do not duplicate normative requirements from OpenSpec; link to them.
Allowed dependency direction: dags/services -> adapters -> application -> domain.
no county adapter is production-ready yet.
The initial human approval rule is an authorized maintainer merging the planning PR.
